fusions.name: Nematocyst Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stinging cells at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 poison damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Colony Seed
fusions.desc: Fires a seeded sting that deals 11 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Spawned Hive
fusions.desc: Grows a humming colony that stands for 15 seconds and stings an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tireless Polyps
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 2% faster per stack (14% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
